free_tier.stated: 333 GB per file, no registration. Registered free members additionally get 111-day retention, send history and a receive folder — all free. No total-storage figure because there is no account-level bucket.

retention.stated: Registered free members additionally get 111-day retention, send history and a receive folder — all free

egress.terms: No bandwidth meter on the free tier; the paid product is a business plan, not storage or transfer.

tooling: Web form at /upload (drag-and-drop, folder upload, password, download-count limit, one-time download). No API, no rclone backend.
chaining: Account-less uploads so 333 GB x unlimited objects; retention 3-111 days chosen per drop means the chain is a re-upload cron rather than an accumulating archive.
limits_note: per-object-cap 333 GB. Retention 3-111 days (free registration unlocks the 111-day end). Optional password, optional download-count cap, optional one-time download.
reliability_note: Newer entrant (the operator runs a comparison blog and scores itself #1, which is a caveat on the ranking but not on the numbers). Operator holds a Japanese PrivacyMark. Ad-supported rather than paid-tier-supported, so the free tier is the business model.
